story-context.title: AI Context Uplift & Benchmark Baseline
story-context.overview: Upgrade the AI instruction bundle (Context Pack) to v2 aligned with the real builder surface post-Stories 6.2.1/6.2.2 — including default canvas width/height per component type for layout. Fix AIAgentPanel runtimeContext: toolbox thumbnails are compact (not canvas 1:1); seed componentFootprints with canvas-scale dimensions (shared policy with new-drop sizing / getComponentDimensions at 100% or extracted estimateConfiguredFootprint). Harden form_ai; add benchmark harness + STORY-6.3-BENCHMARK-BASELINE.md.
